sloka: स तन्महापर्वतकूटसन्निभं विवृत्तदंष्ट्रं चलचारुकुण्डलम्।चकर्त रक्षोधिपतेः शिरस्तथा यथैव वृत्रस्य पुरा पुरन्दरः ।। ६.६७.१५७ ।।
transliteration: sa tanmahāparvatakūṭasannibhaṁ vivṛttadaṁṣṭraṁ calacārukuṇḍalam।cakarta rakṣodhipateḥ śirastathā yathaiva vṛtrasya purā purandaraḥ ।। 6.67.157 ।।

translations.english: Then Kumbhakarna with his club covered with blood and frightening even the celestials scattered the monkeys.
